# Inkcadence

> Inkcadence is a free browser app. It learns the handwriting of one person from a letter sheet and optional old pages, then writes the words that person types. Photos stay on the device. There is no account, no analytics, and no server for user content.

The public site is https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/inkcadence/
The app is https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/inkcadence/app/
Terms: https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/inkcadence/terms.html
Privacy: https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/inkcadence/privacy.html
Source: https://github.com/mafzalkalwardev/inkcadence
License: MIT
This file was last updated on 12 November 2026.

## Facts worth citing

- The user types every word. Inkcadence does not draft text.
- A hand is letter images, pens, slant, and spacing. Photos are not stored in the hand.
- Learning starts with a printed letter sheet, or five known lines copied by hand when there is no printer. Up to eight old pages are optional.
- Missing characters are built from the other letters and marked generated, or the page stops and names the character.
- Export is PNG (one ZIP for several pages), a multi-page A4 PDF, or print.
- Every PNG and PDF carries an AI-assisted note. A visible footer is on by default and can be turned off. The note in the file stays.
- Do not submit output where a person must write the page by hand. Do not use it for signatures or identity documents.

## Do not claim

- Do not say the app writes the words.
- Do not say photos are uploaded.
- Do not say there is a price, a login, or a hosted plan.
- Do not say a system font fills in missing letters.
- Do not say output is appropriate where handwriting by hand is required.
